chunks: He said: Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Muhammad al-Katib narrated to me, he said: al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Zafarani narrated to me, he said: Abu Ishaq Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Thaqafi narrated to us, he said: al-Hasan ibn al-Husayn al-Ansari narrated to us, he said: Sufyan narrated to us, from Fudhayl ibn al-Zubayr, he said: Farwah ibn Mujashi narrated to me, from Abu Jafar Muhammad ibn Ali, peace be upon them both, he said:

Ayesha came to Uthman and said to him: ‘Give me what my father and Umar ibn al-Khattab used to give me.’ He said to her: ‘I find no basis for you in the Book nor in the Sunnah. Rather, your father and Umar ibn al-Khattab used to give you willingly from themselves, and I will not do so.’

She said to him: ‘Then give me my inheritance from the Messenger of God, may God bless him and his family and grant him peace.’ He said to her: ‘Did you not come to me, you and Malik ibn Aws al-Nasri, and you both testified that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and his family, does not leave inheritance, until you both deprived Fatimah of her inheritance and nullified her right? So how do you today seek an inheritance from the Prophet, may God bless him and his family?’

So she left him and departed. And whenever Uthman went out to the prayer, she would take the shirt of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and his family, upon a cane and raise it up, then she would say: ‘Indeed Uthman has contradicted the owner of this shirt and abandoned his tradition.’

key_terms.الكتاب والسنّة: the Book (Quran) and the Sunnah (Prophetic practice)
key_terms.قميص رسول الله: the shirt of the Messenger of God (used as a symbol of prophetic authority)
key_terms.لا يورّث: does not leave inheritance (claim attributed to the Prophet)
key_terms.ميراث: inheritance, the legal share of property left by the deceased

ai.seo_question: What happened when Ayesha asked Uthman for her inheritance from the Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) narrates that Ayesha came to Uthman requesting the same financial grants that Abu Bakr and Umar used to give her. Uthman refused, saying he found no basis for them in the Quran or Sunnah, and that the previous caliphs gave from their own generosity. When Ayesha then demanded her inheritance from the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), Uthman rebuked her, reminding her that she and Malik ibn Aws al-Nasri had testified that the Prophet does not leave inheritance, which was the basis for denying Fatimah her inheritance and nullifying her right. Silenced by this contradiction, Ayesha left. Thereafter, whenever Uthman went out to pray, she would display the Prophet’s shirt on a cane and declare that Uthman had contradicted its owner and abandoned his tradition. This narration illustrates the political tensions during Uthman’s caliphate and the contradictory positions taken regarding prophetic inheritance by those who had previously denied it to Lady Fatimah al-Zahra.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 3. He said: Abul Hasan ‘Ali ibn Muhammad al-Katib reported to me from al-Hasan ibn ‘Ali al-Za’farani, who reported from Abu Ishaq Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Thaqafi, who reported from al-Hasan ibn al-Husayn al-Ansari, who reported from Sufyan, from Fudhail ibn al-Zubair, who reported from Farwah ibn Majashe, from Abu Ja’far Muhammad ibn ‘Ali, peace be upon him that:

Ayesha called upon Uthman and said: "Grant me what my father and Umar ibn al-Khattab used to grant me." He (i.e. Uthman) said: "I do not see any status for you in the Book nor in the (Prophet’s) Traditions. Surely, both your father and Umar ibn al-Khattab, granted you (extra favours) because of their obliging nature, but I shall not do it."

She said: "Then give me my inheritance from the Prophet of Allah". He said: "Did you not come to me, with Malik ibn Aws al-Nasri, to give witness that the messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his progeny, does not bequeath; till you deprived Fatimah from her inheritance and nullified her right? How come you are claiming inheritance today from the Prophet?"

She left him and went away. And when Uthman appeared for the prayers, she raised the Prophet’s shirt on a cane and exclaimed: "Surely, Uthman has contradicted the owner of this shirt and has abandoned his Tradition."
